name: qa-docs
description: Domain documentation for QA: researches the code of many repositories, Jira and Confluence, and writes a verified domain document as short linked pages (overview, one page per process, reference pages) with diagrams rendered to PNG, then builds Confluence pages from it (Confluence HTML with a local preview) and exports them as a page tree with the diagrams uploaded as pictures; also brings old Confluence pages up to date in their own structure. Never changes code.
